text:
cecilia: quick sync - following last night's partial model-load disruptions tied to the cloud auth vendor, let's capture a compact postmortem follow-up and an action rollup that emphasizes ownership, coverage windows, and recurrence detection.
marta-g: Agreed. PM notes spikes ~48-72h. Treat as recurring transient until we have either a vendor SLA change or an internal durable mitigator.
vikram: Inventory of short-term mitigations i see: rollback script for bad manifests (joey), local token cache w/ jittered TTL (sylvia), cross-region failover routing (ops). Missing: an automated model-load circuit-breaker and alert classification so we don't wake everyone for false positives.
joey: I'll take circuit-breaker + test plan. Proposal: when auth p95 > 1.2s for 3 samples in 30m, reduce model-load concurrency by 50% and switch to cached model reads.
sylvia: I'll own the cache smoothing + health probe. Plan: /health/auth-check + webhook to router. When probe fails 3x in 5m, router flips provider -> fallback. ETA: Fri EOD.
incident-bot: Postmortem filed: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RINF-4628 - summary: "intermittent auth provider latency caused partial model load failures".
ops-rotations: Tracker request: include columns: primary, backup, backup_contact, coverage_window_utc, rotation_cadence, observed_interval_days. That makes rotation handoffs explicit.
cecilia: Done. Defaults: infra owners weekly; oncall daily for the 2-week runway; add observed_interval_days where we track the recurrence estimate (48-72).
vikram: Detection metric suggestion: p95_auth_latency (30m moving window) + spike_count over 24h. If spike_count > 3 then auto-page SRE and set router to degraded mode.
joey: Playbook snippet for automation (short):
```
trigger: auth_latency_spike
when: p95_30m >= 1200
actions:
  - notify: #incidents
  - set_mode: degraded_serving
  - reduce_concurrency: 0.5
  - enable: token_cache
```
cecilia: Action rollup (please ack):
- Sylvia: healthcheck endpoint + cache smoothing + PR link (ETA Fri)
- Joey: circuit-breaker implementation + test checklist (ETA Wed)
- Vikram: alert rule + PD mapping + metric dashboards (ETA Mon EOD)
- Ops: add tracker coverage columns + start daily digest for 14 days (ops-bot)
- Cecilia: loop in legal/product for SLA review (roth@, legal@)
sylvia: Ack. Will post PR when ready.
joey: Ack. Will include dry-run routing tests.
vikram: Ack. Creating alerts and PD mapping now.
ops-rotations: Note: prefer degraded serving (smaller batch sizes + read-from-cache) over full fail-open to avoid cascading retries. Router to mark provider unhealthy after 3 failed health checks in 5m.
cecilia: Scheduling: ops-bot to post daily digest @09:30 to #incidents for 14 days. If owners slip on ETA ping me directly. :thumbsup:
